verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Gitea as easy to deploy on your own servers across many OSes and architectures (including Kubernetes), with single-server or replicated setups and support for SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL and other databases. Many hands-on reports confirm self-hosting from a single binary or Docker on low-resource hardware for teams of 1 to 45. missing for 10: a reliable backup/restore story (users report it as weak) and thorough self-hosting documentation (one user had to fall back on Gogs' docs).
